annotation: The participant bent forward, raised their eyebrows high, and stretched their right arm forward and their left arm back.
The participant clasped their hands in front of their mouth with a smile and half-closed eyes.
The participant bowed their head forward, keeping their eyes on their partner, and gaped.
The participant hunched forward to the left, pointed their right index finger into their outstretched left palm, and closed their eyes with raised eyebrows
The participant clasped their hands and gently shook them in a pleading gesture, closed their eyes, and pursed their lips.
The participant closed their eyes, smiling broadly with parted lips, and clasped their hands together and moving them side to side in front of them.
